desc: Read input $N$ and the grid of characters.
Parse the grid into an adjacency structure: `adj[u][v]` stores the label if edge exists, else None. Also build `incoming[u][char]` and `outgoing[v][char]` lists for efficient lookup.
Initialize a 2D array `dist` of size $N \times N$ with infinity.
Set `dist[i][i] = 0` for all $i$, and push $(i, i)$ to `Q`.
For all $i, j$, if edge $i \to j$ exists, set `dist[i][j] = 1` and push $(i, j)$ to `Q`.
While `Q` is not empty, pop $(u, v)$.
